article.content: Mukasa’s first-half goal enough to beat leaders Swansea Canaries suffer sixth straight loss; Watford beat Charlton Nuno Espírito Santo was delighted West Ham finished a “demanding week” by toppling Championship leaders Swansea . Divine Mukasa’s first-half strike in front of a record Swansea.com Stadium crowd of 20,973 gave the Hammers a 1-0 win and took them into second place and within a point of the league leaders. It was their second success in four days after a 6-0 romp at Lincoln , and ended a week that began with a 1-1 home draw against QPR following Jarrod Bowen’s last-gasp penalty miss.
